// RED fixture for `control-plane-pii-free` — the lint MUST reject this.
// A control-plane frame (a cross-cell pointer) carries PII: the control plane must carry OPAQUE
// IDS ONLY (ADR-11, OQ-I). PII is born inside the cell, never here. The fields ARE
// #[personal_data]-tagged (so `no-untagged-personal-data` is satisfied — this fixture isolates
// the control-plane rule): tagging does NOT make PII admissible in the control plane.
pub struct CrossCellPointer {
    pub tenant_id: TenantId,
    #[personal_data(contact)]
    pub email: String,
    #[personal_data(identity)]
    pub display_name: String,
}
